name: Moth
author: Erin Carter
description: A lit window at night: one broad arch-shouldered pane of soft warm light stands off-centre on a near-black field while dark moth silhouettes crawl, perch, and flit against the glass — everything bright is static, everything that moves is darkness.

params.label: Moths
params.effect: Number of silhouettes at the window, from a single lonely visitor to a busy pane of seven.

params.label: Wander speed
params.effect: Pace of the crawling, perching, and flitting traffic across the glass; min is sleepy, max agitated.

params.label: Window width
params.effect: Width of the lit pane in CSS pixels, setting both the bright region and the arena the moths inhabit.

params.label: Flutter
params.effect: Wing-beat speed of the silhouettes; low values glide, high values shiver.
